profile.headline: Software Engineer Identity and Access Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized the SCIM APIs that enterprise merchants use to manage their users, eliminating a scaling penalty that made group updates progressively slower for the largest merchants and delivering an 8.7x speed improvement with constant performance at any group size.
- Drove the architectural shift of  SCIM provisioning  from synchronous to asynchronous processing, achieving a 100% job success rate with zero customer-impacting incidents and supporting substantially higher per-merchant user volumes.
- Built an internal admin console providing per-merchant visibility into SCIM configuration and user and group counts, and enabling support staff to trigger provisioning jobs that previously required an engineer running scripts against the database.
- Designed monitoring dashboards in Datadog and Splunk with error tracking and alerting, and created Postman collections for testing endpoints at scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Next.js · Ruby · MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Backend engineer passionate about building, testing, and making impactful improvements to the services that power the suite of mobile and web applications that supports providers, customers, and internal teams.
- Creates, manages, and optimizes MySQL databases using PHP and Laravel to implement product-driven schema changes.
- Leads breakdown, builds, and QA of features to the core API, microservices, and business-critical web and mobile applications.

positions.title: Lending Operations
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented the Lending Database using SQL and SAP Business Objects. 
- Responsible for building new loan products and policies into the lending database and the operations model. Lead analyst on key performance indicators and portfolio health.
- Responsible for the weekly allocation and disbursement of thousands of loans. Created the disbursement model.
-Designed and built the customer portal using Caspio, HTML, Javascript, and CSS.
-Created and maintained best practices and process documents related to all company systems and interfaces.
-Continuously evaluated business requirements and recommend technologies to drive scale, improve efficiency, and enhance security.

positions.title: Deputy Finance Director
positions.description:
- Key player in raising $1,563,822 for a successful DCCC 2016 Red-to-Blue Race, 
- Planned, recruited, and executed 12 fundraising events. Responsibilities included site selection, cost projection, vendor relationship management and on-site event management. Built relationships with major donors. Ensured that all legal reporting requirements were met.  
- Maintained the NGP Van donor database. Utilized the database to analyze donors and used those insights to improve fundraising. 
- Field manager of 16 employees during the Get Out the Vote Campaign. Ensured employees hit their target metrics, stayed on message, and efficiently executed their canvassing routes. Aggregated iPad data to track the metrics.
- Trained and supervised 10 interns in donor research, event recruiting, and general campaign projects.

positions.title: Lab Technician at the Waste Treatment Facility
positions.description:
-Responsible for daily test ensuring the plant was in compliance with EPA standards. Maintained the sewage treatment plant by mixing and adding chemicals. Monitored and sustained the health of the microorganisms involved in the treatment process.
-Tracked the carbon and heat emitted during the composting cycle along with various environmental factors and researched, tested, and improved the composting system through data driven analysis to achieve staff driven goal of composting all food and human waste produced on island.
-Daily responsibilities included permit testing in compliance with the EPA, mixing chemicals, inspecting the quality of the water, and maintaining the health of the precise microorganisms in the treatment process. Responsible for running and maintaining the Reverse Osmosis Machine.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Summer internship where I installed and performed preliminary testing on a Magnetic Hyperthermia System. This machine will be used to precisely target and attack cancer cells in conjunction with magnetic nanoparticles. Also, responsible for producing laser created tissue-level models and observing, recording, analyzing, and presenting the results. These tissue-level models are used in the study of breast cancer and neural network development.

positions.title: Utility Staff
positions.description: Worked in a variety of departments depending on staffing needs, including kitchen services, managing the front desk, general labor, painter, and event organizer. These jobs required a quick learning curve, the capability to work with minimal supervision, which required independent thinking, creative problem-solving, and the ability to see what needed to be done and to make it happen.
